scheme_name: Group Personal Accident Insurance Scheme For Coir Workers
other_conditions: Applicant must be either a disabled coir worker or a nominee of a disabled or deceased coir worker
If the applicant is a disabled coir worker, the disability percentage must be at least 40%
benefits_summary: Accidental death: Rs.50,000; Permanent total disability: Rs.50,000; Permanent partial disability: Rs.25,000.
documents_required: Evidence of title such as probate, succession certificate, or letters of administration
